text: Which prestige real estate agencies in Melbourne are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

result.keyword: Which prestige real estate agencies in Melbourne are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

items.markdown:
The market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing in Melbourne are **Marshall White Projects** and **Kay & Burton Projects** , supported by international commercial powerhouses like **CBRE Residential Projects** and boutique luxury specialists like **MelCorp Luxe**.[[1]](https://www.fortis.com.au/cbre-residential-projects/)[[2]](https://melcorpluxe.com.au/)

### Marshall White Projects

As an offshoot of one of Melbourne's most dominant prestige residential firms, this division leads in volume and high-end suburban medium-density and apartment marketing.

- [Marshall White Projects](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/projects) has successfully marketed over 265 architectural developments (such as Toorak Park in Armadale and 71 Mathoura in Toorak).
- Operates dedicated state-of-the-art project display suites and sales rooms.
- Deep reach into affluent local buyer networks across Stonnington, Boroondara, and Port Phillip.[[1]](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/projects)[[2]](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/our-projects)[[3]](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/off-the-plan-projects)

### Kay & Burton Projects

A titan in Melbourne’s high-end property landscape, Kay & Burton leverages decades of elite brand equity for top-tier vertical living and premium townhouses.

- [Kay & Burton Projects](https://www.kayburton.com.au/office-locations/kay-burton-projects/25104) manages end-to-end strategy from site feasibility and architectural advisory to global database activation.
- Associated with landmark luxury developments like Mayfair, The Domain, and The Botanical.
- Renowned for discretion, elite private client services, and targeting high-net-worth local and international migration buyers.[[1]](https://www.kayburton.com.au/projects/about-kay-burton-projects/)[[2]](https://www.kayburton.com.au/office-locations/kay-burton-projects/25104)

### CBRE Residential Projects

For large-scale ultra-luxury towers, super-penthouses, and mixed-use architectural high-rises in the CBD and inner fringe, CBRE handles major institutional and private developer pipelines.

- CBRE Australia provides high-end multi-residence marketing, data-driven research, and international buyer funneling.
- Specialises in aligning tier-one architectural designs with institutional-grade development execution.[[1]](https://www.fortis.com.au/cbre-residential-projects/)

### MelCorp Luxe & Boutique Specialists

- MelCorp Luxe focuses heavily on high-end CBD, Southbank, and fringe-suburb luxury apartment sales, elite leasing, and penthouse portfolio management.[[1]](https://melcorpluxe.com.au/)
